en.hubeali:
Humayd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad Bin Sama’at, from Ja’far Bin Sama’at, and someone else, from Aban, from Muhammad Bin Marwan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> passed away and left (as legacy) sixty slaves, so he<sup>asws</sup> emancipated (freed) a third of them. So I<sup>asws</sup> drew lots between them, so I<sup>asws</sup> brought out twenty and freed them’.
en.sarwar: 12. Flumayd ibn Ziyad has narrated from al-Hassan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama‘ah, from Ja‘far ibn Sama‘ah and from more than one person from Aban from Muhammad ibn Marwan who has narrated the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, died and left sixty slaves, of whom he set free one-third. I picked up the ones to be free by means of casting a raffle.’”
